meta.title: cortex-game-engine — 3D game IDE with AI + TypeScript
meta.description: Build 3D games for desktop with TypeScript. Model assets with AI, structure your code with AI — all inside a single IDE.

hero.subtitle: Model 3D assets with AI. Structure your code with AI. All inside a single IDE focused on 3D games — and ship as a desktop installer with one click.

code.title: AI-powered code
code.body: An AI agent lives inside the IDE: it talks with your project, creates ECS components, writes systems, tweaks scenes. Sandboxed to the active project with per-tool approval.

models.title: AI 3D models
models.body_html: Describe the asset, the AI writes the Blender script and exports the .glb ready to drop into the scene. No leaving the IDE.

desktop.title: Desktop games
desktop.body: TypeScript + Three.js + ECS. Live preview while you develop. One click to package as a distributable Windows installer.

stack.title: All in one place
stack.body_html: Monaco editor, embedded terminal, drag-and-drop file tree, hot-reload preview, AI chat in the sidebar and installer generator. Open the IDE, describe what you want and walk out with a playable .exe.

open_source.title: Built in the open. Pull requests welcome.
open_source.body: The whole engine, the IDE, the AI agent and this website live in a single open repository. Found a bug, see how to improve a feature, or want to extend the engine with new capability? Open a PR — or an issue, if you want to discuss first.
